text:
zoe: Heads-up — thinking through a safer shadow rollout for config changes that affect routing/quota policies. Wanted quick feedback.

mira: +1. What's the difference from dry-run?

zoe: dry-run validates config parsing and some static checks. shadow actually runs the new config in parallel (no traffic switching) and collects metrics. We can compare delta for latency, cost, token counts, errors.

alex: +1. We should also tag traces with "config.version" and "mode=shadow" so metrics don't mix.

ken: UI ask: Console should surface side-by-side per-route charts and a checkbox to "promote" after X hours with auto-rollforward.

jules: how do we expose this in the API? any new params?

zoe: proposal: add mode param to apply API: {"mode":"shadow"|"dry_run"|"live", "shadow_ratio":0.2, "ttl":"2h"}

```
# example apply payload
{
  "config_id": "route-priority.v3",
  "mode": "shadow",
  "shadow_ratio": 0.1,
  "telemetry_fields": ["latency_ms","success_rate","token_cost"],
  "note": "shadow run for quota tweak"
}
```

alex: need to be careful with shadow_ratio semantics — shadow_ratio should control percentage of requests duplicated for shadow evaluation, not percentage of traffic affected live.

mira: also consider sampling for heavy clients to avoid duplicate expensive inferences; maybe only shadow for small requests or sample by client_id.

ken: on propagation: we need strong eventual consistency guarantees. If a config rolls out to 3 regions staggered, ensure tracing still links shadow/live pairs.

jules: rollback plan? if shadow shows regressions, we should auto-block promotion and notify owners. Also console should allow quick revoke.

deploy-bot: :rocket: started dry-run validation for config route-priority.v3 (job 4921)

zoe: action items: I'll write an RFC with API contract + telemetry schema + console mockups. alex/ken/mira - can you review in next 48h? I'll open a ticket to add trace tags and the example payload.

mira: will do. quick note — add a metric "shadow_effect_count" and a flag to exclude shadow duplicates from billing aggregates.

alex: agree on billing exclusion. we'll need gating in ingest pipeline.

zoe: thanks — I'll post RFC link here when ready.
